description: Search, fetch, and aggregate public Naver Blog posts — title, body, tags, likes (공감), comments — with a local SQLite store and offline search.

novel_features.name: Engagement diff over time
novel_features.description: See exactly which posts gained likes or comments since you last checked, without re-scraping everything.

novel_features.name: Sponsored-post detector
novel_features.description: Mechanically detects KFTC-required sponsored-post disclosure phrases in the body — 협찬, 체험단, 광고 포함, 유료광고 포함 — and returns a sponsored boolean plus the matched markers.

novel_features.name: Influencer health snapshot
novel_features.description: Given a file of blog IDs, returns posts-this-week, median likes, median comments, sponsored ratio, and days-since-last-post — one command, every influencer.

novel_features.name: Query bundle (cron-mode)
novel_features.description: Runs a list of keyword/hashtag queries from a YAML/JSONL file, enriches every result with engagement, dedupes by canonical URL, and streams a sheet-ready TSV — one binary replaces the Hermes web_search + web_extract + Playwright pipeline.

novel_features.name: Offline Korean FTS
novel_features.description: Korean-aware FTS5 over every post ever cached — title, body, tags, nickname — ranked by FTS relevance and likes.

novel_features.name: Hashtag co-occurrence
novel_features.description: For a target hashtag, returns the top N hashtags that travel with it across the cached corpus — the campaign 'neighborhood'.

novel_features.name: File-driven URL backfill (order-preserving, mixed-format)
novel_features.description: Accepts CSV / JSON column / newline-delimited URLs in any mix of m.blog.naver.com / blog.naver.com / PostView.naver shapes; canonicalizes each; runs concurrent fetches with adaptive rate limiting; preserves input order; emits per-URL error JSON for failures.

novel_features.name: Category browse
novel_features.description: Lists a blog's numbered Naver categories with post counts; --category flag filters feed/local-search results by category number.

novel_features.name: Comments extraction
novel_features.description: Fetch the actual content of comments on a Naver Blog post — author, body, timestamps, like counts — via the public cbox endpoint. Optional flat or nested-tree output.

novel_features.name: Blog profile metadata
novel_features.description: Get rich blog profile data: subscriber count, daily/total visitor counts, Naver Power Blog status, directory category, profile/cover images — everything Naver shows on the blog homepage.
